title: Error, Offer, Cleared and Request are declared and coded twice in wire.rs
body:
`ViewerMessage` and `ServerMessage` each have `Error`, `Offer`, `Cleared` and `Request` with the same fields. Each is encoded twice and decoded twice, about 140 lines, and only `Writer::offer` is shared. `Outbox::push_viewer_message` and `push_server_message` are one-line forwards.

Encoding itself is written once. `Writer` and `Args` own the primitives and `finish` does the length arithmetic, so no message carries its own length math. A macro declaring each of the 36 variants once would cut about 500 lines to 150. I would not take it: the arms read straight through, and the macro would not.

## Proposal

`wire::Clip { Offer, Cleared, Request }` carried as `ViewerMessage::Clip(Clip)` and `ServerMessage::Clip(Clip)`, with one `Writer::clip` and one `Args::clip` and the opcode as the direction's base plus the clip index. `Error` the same way. About 70 lines fewer.
